name: VPN
author: Valentin Basin
description: VPN and WireGuard connection status and quick connect/disconnect for NetworkManager profiles. Updates on NetworkManager events and is fully keyboard-navigable.

barWidget.description: Shows active VPN and WireGuard connections and lets you connect, disconnect or cancel any NetworkManager VPN profile with the mouse or the keyboard (arrow keys/hjkl to move, Enter/Space to activate, Esc to close).
